description: What changed in AI regulation recently: records newly added, records whose status, dates or milestones changed (with the previous and new values), and dated milestones that fell due in the window, such as a law taking effect. Each result carries a `change` saying what happened and when. Rewritten analysis text is not counted as a change.

days.description: Look-back window in days (default 30; free: up to 90, with an API key: up to 365)

limit.description: Max results (free: up to 5; with an API key: up to 50)

name: recent_changes
title: Recent regulation changes
